observations: Photo 0 shows a DAF engine cover with text “DAF 24 VALVE” and “DAF” on the valve cover; also shows an engine bay with turbo/exhaust plumbing.
Photo 1 shows the engine assembled in a bay with multiple hoses/pipes; a large fan/air intake housing is visible; engine appears mounted/complete.
Photo 2 shows the full engine laid out/installed with two valve covers labeled “DAF”; multiple accessories and wiring/hose routing visible.

claims.claim: Clean and powerful Trailer Head Engine, in excellent condition and ready for work.
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine with covers and components present, but condition/“ready for work” (leaks, compression, mounting integrity) is not verifiable from images.
No performance test results, dyno, or running video shown.
No import documents, VIN/engine number plate, or shipping paperwork shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No start-up video, sound recording, diagnostic report, mileage/ECU readout, or evidence of tamper/never-opened is shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually be running/healthy (compression, injector condition, turbo health, coolant/oil leaks) despite “tested and working” claim.
risks.proof: Short video of cold start + idle for several minutes, plus a dashboard/ECU diagnostic screen showing no active faults.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: “No knock” could be untrue or intermittent (rod/bearing noise under load).
risks.proof: Video of engine running under light load (or revving) with clear audio, ideally from the front/side where noise would be audible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible internal noise/unknown wear.

risks.risk: “Never opened” and “low mileage” cannot be confirmed; engine could have been rebuilt or have worn components.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seals/gaskets, cylinder head bolts/stamp marks, and any tamper evidence; plus engine number/serial plate photo and service history if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown history (worst case: may have been opened/repaired).

risks.risk: Exact engine variant/spec is unclear (DAF 24 valve shown, but displacement/series not readable). Wrong variant can change parts compatibility and price.
risks.proof: Photo of the full engine ID/label/plate (engine code/serial) and any stamped part numbers; also photo of the ECU label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest compatible/most generic assumption for a DAF 24-valve trailer head engine.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories/hoses/lines not visible in these angles (alternator, sensors, fuel lines, turbo hoses, wiring connectors).
risks.proof: Inventory checklist photos: front, rear, both sides; close-ups of fuel system connections, sensor plugs, turbo inlet/outlet, and all belts/hoses.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as complete but with unknown accessory condition (worst case: some parts may need replacement).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the engine ID/serial plate (engine code) and any stamped numbers so the exact DAF model/variant is confirmed.
Send a start-up video (cold start if possible) with clear audio showing stable idle and no warning lights.
Send ECU/digital diagnostic report (fault codes) or a screenshot from a scanner showing no active errors.
Send close-ups of seals/gaskets and any tamper evidence to support “never opened.”
Send photos of all sides (front/rear/left/right) and a quick parts inventory to confirm nothing is missing.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a DAF 24-valve engine, but the key pricing drivers (exact variant, verified working status, mileage/history, and completeness) are not provable from images alone. Request the decisive ID and proof-of-running/diagnostics before pricing.
